title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Section g) 'Faisceautisation' asks how to sheafify the divided-power de Rham construction of the previous pages.

On the previous pages, for a simplicial set X_* and a base ring k, Grothendieck built a bicomplex C^{..}_DRpd(X_*,k). It is assembled from divided-power algebras Γ^*L_{*k} tensored with exterior algebras on the standard simplices. He also built its predual coalgebra C^DRpd_{..}(X_*,Z). Together these serve as an integral, all-characteristic substitute for Sullivan's rational polynomial de Rham algebra A_PL(X_*).

Here he makes four points.
(1) The construction makes sense verbatim when k is a sheaf of rings (an 'Anneau') in an arbitrary topos. This gives sheaves of pd de Rham complexes.
(2) He wants derived direct images Rf_* for a morphism of topoi f: X → Y, with k an O_Y-algebra. These should live in suitable derived categories whose objects are such multiplicatively structured complexes, not just complexes of modules. The marginal phrase 's'apparentant à des cat. fibrées' suggests these derived categories should vary in a fibred way over the topos.
(3) His proposed method is the classical one: compare a given complex to a pd de Rham complex with flasque components, i.e. a multiplicative flasque resolution. He immediately doubts whether there are enough of them.
(4) He notes that the same problem already exists for Sullivan-type (rational commutative dga) de Rham complexes. He records it as an open problem posed by Deligne even in the simplest case: X = the topos of simplicial sets (presheaves on Δ), Y = the point. In other words: how do you define RΓ for presheaves of commutative dg algebras on Δ so that it stays commutative? He adds that, if memory serves, there is a 'truc' that works for (paracompact) topological spaces. Presumably this is fine/soft sheaves of Sullivan or PL forms (Cartan, Swan, Sullivan), which give multiplicative acyclic resolutions there.

In modern language, he is asking for a multiplicative derived pushforward. That means a functor on sheaves of commutative (or pd, i.e. 'E∞-with-divided-powers' integral) cochain algebras that lifts the usual Rf_* on underlying complexes. The goal is to globalize rational, and ultimately integral or p-adic, homotopy-type invariants over a base.
errors: No mathematical error. The worry 'y en a-t-il assez/trop?' is the real obstruction: in a general topos, flasque objects carrying a strictly commutative or pd-multiplicative structure need not suffice to resolve.
The standard Godement resolution is cosimplicial. Totalizing it with Alexander–Whitney products destroys strict commutativity, which is exactly why the naive approach fails.

Over Q this was later overcome with the Thom–Whitney simple functor. In positive or mixed characteristic, strictly commutative cochain models do not exist at all because of Steenrod operations, so any solution must use a bicomplex, cosimplicial, or pd structure like Grothendieck's.

ideas.what: Sheafified divided-power de Rham (Sullivan-type) complexes for a ring object k in an arbitrary topos
ideas.modern_name: Sheaves of pd/simplicial commutative cochain algebras; integral analogue of sheafified A_PL
ideas.usually_credited_to: Sullivan (A_PL, 1977), Swan (1975), Cartan (1976) for the rational sheaf versions; the integral pd version is not standard

ideas.what: Derived direct image Rf_* for a morphism of topoi in a derived category of multiplicative (commutative dg / pd) complexes, computed via multiplicative flasque resolutions
ideas.modern_name: Multiplicative / Thom–Whitney derived direct image; pushforward of sheaves of E∞-algebras
ideas.usually_credited_to: Navarro Aznar, 'Sur la théorie de Hodge–Deligne' (Invent. Math. 1987), Thom–Whitney simple of the Godement resolution; ∞-categorically Lurie
ideas.where_published: Possibly echoed in Pursuing Stacks / Les Dérivateurs in general form; unsure

ideas.what: Attribution to Deligne of the open problem of defining RΓ for presheaves of commutative dgas on Δ (simplicial-sets topos to point)
ideas.modern_name: Commutative cochains / homotopy limits of cdgas; Thom–Whitney totalization
ideas.usually_credited_to: Problem associated with Deligne's Hodge-theoretic programme (mixed Hodge structures on homotopy); solved by Navarro Aznar 1987

ideas.what: Remark that a trick works for (paracompact) topological spaces
ideas.modern_name: Fine/soft sheaves of PL or Sullivan forms giving multiplicative acyclic resolutions

missed.claim: Grothendieck proposes an integral/pd version of the multiplicative derived direct image: Rf_* for sheaves of DRpd bicomplexes over an O_Y-algebra k, for arbitrary morphisms of topoi. Navarro Aznar's solution is only over Q. An integral analogue would combine DRpd (pd Whitney forms) with a Thom–Whitney totalization of the cosimplicial Godement resolution. I am not aware that this explicit analogue has been written down; modern work instead handles it ∞-categorically.
missed.quote: On aimerait ... définir des op. Rf_* dans des cat. dérivées convenables formées de tels complexes, quand f : X → Y est un morphisme de topos
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Strict pd models of integral cochains with functorial pushforward bear on p-adic and integral homotopy theory (Mandell), Toën's affine stacks / schematization, and derived rings with divided powers (Brantner–Mathew). An explicit strict construction could complement the ∞-categorical machinery.

missed.claim: This is a historical record, around 1975-76, that Deligne posed the commutative-RΓ problem on the simplicial-sets topos, and that Grothendieck connected it to his integral pd de Rham programme. This predates Navarro Aznar's 1987 resolution over Q.
missed.quote: le Pb est ouvert — et posé par Deligne — quand X = topos des ens. simpliciaux, Y = topos ponctuel
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Documents the origin and circulation of the problem that led to the Thom–Whitney simple functor, and Grothendieck's awareness of it.

deep.surprise_reason: The page states a natural problem (multiplicative Rf_* for sheafified pd de Rham complexes) without solving it. Its rational case is known and was solved by Navarro Aznar. The interest is historical: an explicit attribution to Deligne, and the integral pd framing over arbitrary topoi, which remains less developed in strict form.
transcription_corrections: 'muni d'une topos[?]' should probably read 'Anneau dans un topos' (or 'd'un topos').
'(mais y en a-t-il trop[?] ?)' probably reads '(mais y en a-t-il assez ?)'. This fits the question of enough flasque objects.
'quand f : X → Y est un morphisme de topos ... si k est une O_Y-Algèbre': read 'et k est une O_Y-Algèbre'. The next clause is 'Le même Pb se pose certes d'ailleurs déjà ...'.
'c'est le Pb est ouvert' should read 'et le Pb est ouvert' (or 'ce Pb est ouvert').
'X = (Ens)'[?]' is likely 'X = (Δ°Ens)^' or similar, i.e. the topos of simplicial sets.
'truc[?]' is plausible ('un truc qui marche'). 'topologiques' is written above 'paracompacts' as a correction or addition.
